name: game-maker
description: Configurable tile board game engine and playtest harness

scripts.build: npm run build -w @game-maker/engine && npm run build -w @game-maker/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @game-maker/engine && npm run test -w @game-maker/game-library
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @game-maker/engine && npm run typecheck -w @game-maker/game-library && npm run typecheck -w @game-maker/web
